overall_intent: A portrait-guided fictional explorer expends her last resource on a chosen card to send false footsteps away from the exit she is crossing. Skill rule, choice, directed effect and tactical benefit must read together.

prop.reason: The held choice needs distinct physical alternatives and a selected action-bearing card.
prop.expressive_goal: Make selecting a skill materially visible.
observable_targets: one played card with an identifiable effect
owner_relations: explorer hands hold alternatives and selected card
selected card originates the footprint trail
required_constraints: preserve game-like rule and visible consequence
prop.role_focus: A carried card hand with a selected ability whose visible emitted effect makes a route usable, with unchosen alternatives still distinguishable.
prop.scene_context: A fictional explorer in a salt-mine junction diverts a bronze sentinel by creating ghost footsteps.

grounds.quote: Her left hand holds two clearly separate unplayed cards

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: This role develops the independently frozen card diversion; it adds no requester ownership to the salt mine, cards or sentinel.

relational_action.reason: The card should visibly change what the sentinel does and where the explorer can go.
relational_action.expressive_goal: Connect chosen ability, guard response and passage.
required_constraints: all consequential endpoints share a frame
relational_action.role_focus: An explorer chooses an ability that produces decoy footprints; a sentinel turns toward those same marks while the explorer crosses the exit it has left open.
relational_action.scene_context: A forked underground dungeon is the physical stage for a bounded game skill choice.

grounds.quote: The bronze sentinel's head and trumpet-shaped listening horn have turned toward those same luminous footprints

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: This role develops the independently frozen card diversion; it adds no requester ownership to the salt mine, cards or sentinel.

visible_text.reason: A bounded resource makes this an operational game rule in the scene.
visible_text.expressive_goal: Readable skill selection and spent resource.
owner_relations: skill title belongs to selected card
resource display belongs to the explorer
required_constraints: legible text must not replace physical causation
visible_text.role_focus: A compact in-world skill display pairs the name of the selected ability with an exhausted numerical resource counter, beside the acting hand.
visible_text.scene_context: The ability has just created false tracks that redirect a guard and permit passage.
